snippet.title: CORPOREAL | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Zoom in on a brand-new teaser for Corporeal, a chill-but-chilling narrative investigation game about piecing together a mysterious past in mid-90s NZ, through a cursed family photo album. Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255140/CORPOREAL/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
